notes.title: Healing Pistol
notes.content:
The healing pistol is here!
          -It may not look like much, but the healing pistol is capable of healing 100 dps.
          -If you are under attack, you are guaranteed to die if you try to heal mid battle.
          -The healing pistol is a good way to have your friends support you in battle without
              the safety of a ship. You may have a lot of healers, but they are not long for this world
              if you cant protect them
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44372617/da8cb64f26f78004c25a88ab3a26f4fad0c7d764.png[/img]

Bug fixes
-fixed issue where clients speed would not update when they boarded a vehicle
-updated player controls ui to include info on how to switch weapons and how to 
        fire weapons.

notes.title: Delaying Release
notes.content:
Long is the road that leads to success. 

The burden of working a full time job while creating a game
has slowed progress significantly. 

In September 2024, I scrapped the splitscreen project and
     decided to remake the game online.
Unfortunately, All of the single-player code  and features must be rewritten to
        function online. This process is taking a lot of time.

The release date has been pushed back by another year, but it is indeed coming. 
        There is a closed pre-alpha version of the game that is being worked on daily. 
        Network tests have been conducted. The online portion of the game works,
        and it works well.

I will continue to post patch notes and updates like a real developer should.
       Thank you for your patience and support for this project.


New Features
      -Added Glossary
               The glossary is a question(?) mark that appears at the bottom left hand
               side of the screen. Open the glossary to learn everything from hosting
               your own server, joining games, controls, game-play objectives, mining
               and more. With this glossary, players should be able to play the game 
               without needing me to walk them through it over chat.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44372617/9e6c36f429670f2c001ba2cca6068e522b296405.png[/img]

       -NPC Mining Fleets
                 There are npc mining fleets that will help you break the bigger rocks
                  into smaller rocks. The larger rocks respawn, but the smaller ones will
                  not. Small rocks and minerals will despawn after 500 seconds to keep
                  the server uncluttered, be mindful of this. Mining NPC's are neutral and
                  will only attack if attacked first.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44372617/22c9173fbce47c265ac65db27a4604c1102d2983.png[/img]
        -Flagship NPC Fleet
                 The flagship npc fleet spawns after 10 minutes of play and they head up
                 the north path. Flagship fleets consist of 1 cruiser, 2 destroyers, and 8 Frigates.
                 Trying to take them on alone is guaranteed to end with your death. In the future,
                 the flagships will have a DJ script allowing them to play their nation's theme song
                 while they go to war.


Bug Fixes
        -Fixed the DPS Meter.
              The DPS meter previously only functioned for the server host.
              This is no longer the case. Everyone can see their DPS now.

UI Changes
        -Changed Fullscreen toggle image to from an eject symbol, to a display symbol.

notes.title: Demo Is Out! Go Nuts!
notes.content:
Welcome To Future Weapon 2D's Demo

My friends in real life either love it or hate it.
Let me know what you love and what you hate.

The game is complex and the demo quickly escalates from walk in the park to Elden Ring.
Also, watch out for sharks! They do a lot of damage.

If you can complete the final mission 'War Of The Worlds', send me a screenshot of Lt. Pullen with
no question mark over his head. 
I won't believe you pulled it off otherwise!

Good Luck Captain!
